items.title: Relief crews close two highways as plateau rivers rise
items.summary: Forecasters expect the rains to ease by the weekend, but warn that reservoirs are near capacity.

items.title: Lenders expect mortgage rates to hold steady through the winter
items.summary: A survey of regional banks found most see little change before spring, after a year of slow declines.

items.title: Valley orchards report their best apple harvest in a decade
items.summary: A mild spring and a dry September pushed yields up by a fifth; cider makers expect lower prices.

items.title: Students install water-quality sensors along the river
items.summary: The high-school project will publish temperature and oxygen readings every fifteen minutes.

items.title: Northgate Bridge lane closures to end Friday, the city says
items.summary: Crews are finishing the lamp restoration; the last detour signs come down at the end of the week.

items.title: City publishes its snow-plowing priority map
items.summary: Hospital routes and bus lines are cleared first, then hills, then residential streets.

items.title: Publish every reading from the river sensors
items.summary: Open data from the students' project would do more for trust than any glossy report.
items.stance: The river data should be public in real time.
